title: RETRACTION: PW06 Suppresses Cancer Cell Metastasis in Human Pancreatic Carcinoma MIA PaCa‐2 Cells via the Inhibitions of p‐Akt/mTOR/NF‐κB and MMP2/MMP9 Signaling Pathways In Vitro
content:
RETRACTION: Y.-P. Huang, C.-A. Yeh, Y.-S. Ma, P.-Y. Chen, K.-C. Lai, J.-C. Lien, and W.-T. Hsieh, “ PW06 Suppresses Cancer Cell Metastasis in Human Pancreatic Carcinoma MIA PaCa-2 Cells via the Inhibitions of p-Akt/mTOR/NF-κB and MMP2/MMP9 Signaling Pathways In Vitro ,” Environmental Toxicology 39, no. 5 (2024): 2768–2781, https://doi.org/10.1002/tox.24143.

The above article, published online on 24 January 2024 in Wiley Online Library (http://onlinelibrary.wiley.com/), has been retracted by agreement between the journal Editor-in-Chief, April Rodd; and Wiley Periodicals LLC. Following an investigation by the publisher, the parties have concluded that this article was accepted solely on the basis of a compromised peer review process. Therefore, the article must be retracted.

Author J.-C. Lien disagrees with the retraction. Authors Y.-P. Huang, C.-A. Yeh, Y.-S. Ma, P.-Y. Chen, K.-C. Lai and W.-T. Hsieh did not respond to communications from the Publisher regarding the retraction.
